prerequisites: Basic knowledge of high school calculus

learning_outcomes.text: Understanding fundamental concepts and results in mathematical analysis.
Applying calculus methods to problems in optimization, statistics, machine learning.
Efficient and productive work rules applied in scientific and educational domains.
Methods and techniques for doing research and for presenting one's work.

syllabus_topics: Series of real numbers (II). Power series
Functions of one variable: limits, continuity, differentiability
Functions of several variables: limits and continuity
Partial derivatives and differentiability. Gradient descent
Higher order derivatives. Hessian matrix. Local extrema
assessment_rules: Attendance at 75% of the seminars is required. The final grade must be greater than or equal to 5. The final grade is calculated as 50% from the exam, 30% from the midterm test, 10% from seminar activity, and 10% from homework.
